steps.text: The shady undercurrents flow beneath the clamor of Carnevale. Yet Leontuzzo, in his coma, is unaware of any of this.
Leontuzzo has a dream.
In his dream, he recalls his long-forgotten past.
The central figure of this dream is neither his mentor and friend, Lavinia, nor his close companion Demetri, nor even his father, Bernardo.
It is not Carracci, who guided him with such a steady hand, nor is it Rubio, who startled the entire city with a single gunshot.
It is an old man.
An old man that Leontuzzo has buried in the deepest recesses of his memory.
Back then, the Grey Hall had just passed the resolution to construct a new nomadic city.
Back then, Lavinia had not yet arrived in Volsinii, and he, following his father's orders, took over the 'family business'.
Back then, Siracusa's rainy season was still a long one.

steps.name: Old Judge
steps.text: I hereby find Enzo... not guilty!

steps.name: Pastry Shop Owner
steps.text: Not guilty?! He ripped out my sister's vocal chords! Julia is still in a coma!

steps.name: Old Judge
steps.text: There is no evidence directly implicating him.

steps.name: Pastry Shop Owner
steps.text: Of course not! He destroyed the evidence!

steps.name: Pastry Shop Owner
steps.text: And he assaulted me!

steps.name: Old Judge
steps.text: According to the witnesses' testimony, you were the one who provoked the conflict, and his actions should be considered self-defense.

steps.name: Old Judge
steps.text: However, Enzo has said he understands your anger and will not take action against you, either criminally or civilly, in this matter.

steps.name: Pastry Shop Owner
steps.text: You mean, he forgives me?

steps.name: Arrogant Mafioso
steps.text: You are Julia's brother, so you're my brother as well.

steps.name: Arrogant Mafioso
steps.text: We need to maintain a good relationship, Ennio.

steps.name: Pastry Shop Owner
steps.text: You, you bastardo! I never liked you from the start!

steps.name: Pastry Shop Owner
steps.text: Julia insisted on being with you, so I reluctantly agreed.

steps.name: Pastry Shop Owner
steps.text: And look what happened! You've made her a mute!

steps.name: Arrogant Mafioso
steps.text: I already told you. That has nothing to do with me.

steps.name: Pastry Shop Owner
steps.text: She fled back home!

steps.name: Arrogant Mafioso
steps.text: As her boyfriend, I'm very upset about this myself.

steps.name: Arrogant Mafioso
steps.text: Don't worry. After I bring her back to our home, I'll get some of my boys together and we'll go find the real culprit!

spans.text: Don't worry. After I bring her back to
home, I'll get some of my boys together and we'll go find the real culprit!

steps.name: Pastry Shop Owner
steps.text: No. I won't let you take her away.

steps.name: Old Judge
steps.text: Signori, what is the meaning of this?

steps.name: Fierce Mafioso
steps.text: We're here for a pickup.

steps.name: Old Judge
steps.text: But court is still in session.

steps.name: Fierce Mafioso
steps.text: Then let's wrap it up quick.

steps.name: Fierce Mafioso
steps.text: We're here to take Julia home.

steps.name: Old Judge
steps.text: Well... in that case...

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: Wait.

steps.name: Fierce Mafioso
steps.text: Leontuzzo?! So the Bellone Underboss has made an appearance.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: Regardless of the circumstances, Julia did flee back home.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: She should be allowed to rest quietly until she wakes up.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: Even if Enzo is her boyfriend, he should only be allowed to visit her.

steps.name: Pastry Shop Owner
steps.text: I won't allow him to set foot in my home!

steps.name: Arrogant Mafioso
steps.text: Ennio, don't get carried away.

steps.name: Arrogant Mafioso
steps.text: If Signor Bellone hadn't spoken up, your pastry shop would be a pile of ashes by tomorrow!

steps.name: Pastry Shop Owner
steps.text: You—

steps.name: Old Judge
steps.text: Ennio, please respect the court's ruling.

steps.name: Pastry Shop Owner
steps.text: Yes... Your Honor.

steps.name: Old Judge
steps.text: Enzo, do you accept Signor Bellone's proposal?

steps.name: Arrogant Mafioso
steps.text: The Bellone Underboss has spoken. Of course I accept.

steps.name: Arrogant Mafioso
steps.text: After we're done here in court, I'll go to see her.

steps.name: Old Judge
steps.text: Well then, this concludes our proceedings here today.

steps.name: Old Judge
steps.text: Buongiorno, Signor Bellone.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: Buongiorno, Judge Russo.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: Lavinia misses you very much.

steps.name: Old Judge
steps.text: I have the letter she sent me. It seems she has a good relationship with Famiglia Bellone.

steps.name: Old Judge
steps.text: You are not satisfied with the outcome here in court today.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: Enzo is behind this. Everyone can see that.

steps.name: Old Judge
steps.text: I know what you mean.

steps.name: Old Judge
steps.text: However, he has destroyed all the evidence.

steps.name: Old Judge
steps.text: Enzo has some complicated famiglia connections.

steps.name: Old Judge
steps.text: This is the most I can do, given the circumstances.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: Lavinia tells me you are a man who does not tolerate injustice.

steps.name: Old Judge
steps.text: Times have changed, Signore.

steps.name: Old Judge
steps.text: People can change as well.

steps.name: Old Judge
steps.text: Now, if you don't mind, I shall take my leave.

steps.name: Old Judge
steps.text: I still have some matters to attend to. Ennio must be quite upset right now, and I need to go talk him through it.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: As you wish.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: Ever since the Grey Hall announced the construction of a new nomadic city, Volsinii has been in chaos.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: As you've just seen, the courts stopped functioning a while ago.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: Judge Russo is one of the few judges in Volsinii who's still got the balls to hold trial.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: I know.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: Then when do you plan to come back?

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: Don't you think it's odd for Enzo to be so public about searching for his girlfriend?

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: This isn't some 'lovers' quarrel'—it's clearly more than that.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: He's very impatient.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: Are you saying that Julia knows something she isn't supposed to know?

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: And he won't let it go.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: Enzo is with Famiglia Stracci, and they've been causing trouble lately. You've been wanting to make a move against them, right?

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: Looks like Leon isn't planning on playing the righteous hero. Funny enough, I got some interesting news of my own.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: Hmm?

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: There's an old folk legend among the civilians in Volsinii.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: Over the years, many mafiosi who testified in court have met untimely deaths.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: The civilians say it's 'divine punishment'.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: Well, is it?

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: Hardly.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: The deaths of these people, while somewhat peculiar, are nothing more than assassinations by rival famiglie.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: There's no chance someone is pulling strings behind the scenes?

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: They would need a thorough understanding of all famiglia dynamics, as well as the ability to leave no trace of their existence.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: I doubt such a person exists in Volsinii.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: Perhaps you're right.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: They're getting ready to make a move. We'll talk about this later.

steps.name: Fierce Mafioso
steps.text: Heh. I never expected the Bellone Underboss to show up there.

steps.name: Arrogant Mafioso
steps.text: Whatever, as long as I can still see Julia.

steps.name: Fierce Mafioso
steps.text: What really happened between you two?

steps.name: Arrogant Mafioso
steps.text: Nothing, just a misunderstanding. You should head back now. I'll go find Julia.

steps.name: Arrogant Mafioso
steps.text: Tell the Don I'll explain it to him when I get back.

steps.name: Fierce Mafioso
steps.text: Good. Glad you understand it's on you to explain it to the boss.

steps.name: Arrogant Mafioso
steps.text: *sigh*

steps.name: Arrogant Mafioso
steps.text: Well, I better go to Julia before I see the Don...

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: You're ditching your wingman.... interesting.

steps.name: Arrogant Mafioso
steps.text: After I see Julia, I'll need her to...

steps.name: Arrogant Mafioso
steps.text: Hey! Outta my way!

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: That's.... an Iberian outfit?

steps.name: Arrogant Mafioso
steps.text: Guh—

steps.name: Angry Assassin
steps.text: Go to hell!

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: What is this, a mob hit? I better stop—

steps.name: Strange Assassin
steps.text: Stop!

steps.name: Angry Assassin
steps.text: But—

steps.name: Strange Assassin
steps.text: We're here to take him back alive.

steps.name: Strange Assassin
steps.text: Just leave him to me.

steps.name: Angry Assassin
steps.text: Alright...

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: It seems you guessed wrong, Demetri.

steps.name: Arrogant Mafioso
steps.text: Ouch—

steps.name: Arrogant Mafioso
steps.text: What happened to me...?

steps.name: Arrogant Mafioso
steps.text: I remember I was going to look for Julia... in the park, when I was jumped by some weirdo in strange clothes... and then...

steps.name: Arrogant Mafioso
steps.text: They knocked me out!

steps.name: Arrogant Mafioso
steps.text: But where am I now? Did someone rescue me?

steps.name: Strange Assassin
steps.text: You will die here.

steps.name: Arrogant Mafioso
steps.text: Who, who are you?

steps.name: Arrogant Mafioso
steps.text: You're really gonna kill me?! I'm a Stracci!!

steps.name: Strange Assassin
steps.text: Famiglia Stracci?

steps.name: Strange Assassin
steps.text: You colluded with the Saluzzos to sell the Straccis' stockpile of Originium weapons.

steps.name: Strange Assassin
steps.text: Your boss is looking for you. I bet he wants to ask you about that, no?

steps.name: Arrogant Mafioso
steps.text: Is Julia up yet?!

steps.name: Strange Assassin
steps.text: Poor Julia. She stumbled upon your business with the Saluzzos, so you tore out her vocal chords.

steps.name: Arrogant Mafioso
steps.text: She was planning to rat me out.

steps.name: Arrogant Mafioso
steps.text: I'm not out to kill her. I still love her.

steps.name: Angry Assassin
steps.text: You dare claim you love her?!

steps.name: Arrogant Mafioso
steps.text: You're... Ennio?! Yes, you've gotta be Ennio!

steps.name: Arrogant Mafioso
steps.text: I get it. You're upset, and you got a bunch of people together to 'scare' me, right? This is all some kinda show?

steps.name: Angry Assassin
steps.text: No. You will die here today.

steps.name: Arrogant Mafioso
steps.text: Do you understand what you're saying here, pal?

steps.name: Angry Assassin
steps.text: Of course.

steps.name: Angry Assassin
steps.text: Your Honor, if you will.

steps.name: Arrogant Mafioso
steps.text: You people are crazy. You're all nuts!

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: A judge has the power to convict, but not the right to personally take a life.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: Moreover, based on what I just heard—there still seems to be some 'wiggle room' in regards to Enzo's sentence.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: Am I right, Judge Russo?

steps.name: Arrogant Mafioso
steps.text: Now's the chance—

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: No one said you could leave, Enzo.

steps.name: Arrogant Mafioso
steps.text: Guh...

steps.name: Old Judge
steps.text: You never cease to surprise me, Signor Bellone.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: The surprising one here is you, Your Honor.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: You really had me fooled with your 'professionalism'.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: I never suspected that, behind the scenes, you hold the law in complete disregard.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: Your actions make you utterly unworthy to wear a robe and hold a gavel.

steps.name: Old Judge
steps.text: But, Leontuzzo, when have rulings against the Siracusan famiglie ever truly followed the law?

steps.name: Old Judge
steps.text: No one cares about the evidence.

steps.name: Old Judge
steps.text: No one cares about the outcomes.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: I won't let this happen.

steps.name: Old Judge
steps.text: Say what you will, but I have seen these things countless times.

steps.name: Old Judge
steps.text: Moreover, if one crime isn't enough to warrant death, what about ten? Or a hundred?

steps.name: Old Judge
steps.text: Mafiosi love to talk of their opulent famiglie.

steps.name: Old Judge
steps.text: But how many civilians have bled for this opulence? How many skeletons are there in the closet?

steps.name: Old Judge
steps.text: Are these sins not worthy of capital punishment?

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: Following your logic, every mafioso should be killed.

steps.name: Old Judge
steps.text: Yes, and what of it?

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: Sorry...

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: But I can't let you kill him.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: No one has the right to take another's life.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: One judge who ignores the law... paves the way for a lawless future for countless others.

steps.name: Old Judge
steps.text: 'The future'? Look around you, young Leontuzzo.

steps.name: Old Judge
steps.text: Siracusa has no future!

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: It does indeed. It's merely obscured by Signora Sicilia, the Dodici Famiglie, and this torrential rain.

steps.name: Old Judge
steps.text: Even if Lavinia had the ability to influence you, she could never shake your foundation—everything you've been exposed to as a Don's heir—

steps.name: Old Judge
steps.text: Systemic violence, deep-seated arrogance, and pretentious hypocrisy.

steps.name: Old Judge
steps.text: However, you, Signore, you seem to be different.

steps.name: Old Judge
steps.text: You genuinely believe in the existence of justice.

steps.name: Old Judge
steps.text: You, an heir to a famiglia, are standing here to uphold the dignity of the law.

steps.name: Old Judge
steps.text: Do you understand? This is—

steps.name: Old Judge
steps.text: Nothing less than the greatest insult to people like us.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: Hmph, I'll have to retreat, with Enzo, for now.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: Damnit! Where did he go?!

steps.name: Arrogant Mafioso
steps.text: Sorry, Signor Bellone.

steps.name: Arrogant Mafioso
steps.text: If I stay here, these guys are gonna kill me, but if I go back to the famiglia with you...the Don will kill me!

steps.name: Arrogant Mafioso
steps.text: I don't wanna get killed.

steps.name: Arrogant Mafioso
steps.text: Merda! That judge is off his rocker!

steps.name: Arrogant Mafioso
steps.text: How dare you lay hands on a made man?!

steps.name: Arrogant Mafioso
steps.text: If Leontuzzo hadn't stepped in, I would have been dead meat.

steps.name: Arrogant Mafioso
steps.text: Alas, I must apologize to you, Signor Bellone.

steps.name: Arrogant Mafioso
steps.text: I sincerely appreciate you saving me from that evil judge, but you already know about my betrayal.

steps.name: Arrogant Mafioso
steps.text: Going back with you is no different than jumping off a bridge.

steps.name: Arrogant Mafioso
steps.text: But then, what should I do?

steps.name: Arrogant Mafioso
steps.text: Go hide with the Saluzzos?

steps.name: Arrogant Mafioso
steps.text: They might not even think I'm worth their time... wait!

steps.name: Arrogant Mafioso
steps.text: Ratting out Judge Russo would generate massive headlines!

steps.name: Arrogant Mafioso
steps.text: Just think of it! A bunch of civilians killing mafiosi right under the dons' noses!

steps.name: Arrogant Mafioso
steps.text: The balls on these pricks!

steps.name: Arrogant Mafioso
steps.text: Come to think of it, there must have been some Saluzzos killed too.

steps.name: Arrogant Mafioso
steps.text: I'm sure they'll wanna know about that!

steps.name: Pastry Shop Owner
steps.text: Signor Bellone...

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: Calm down, Ennio.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: I come not for revenge, nor to ask you about Judge Russo.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: I just have one question for you.

steps.name: Pastry Shop Owner
steps.text: Which is...?

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: Why do you trust Judge Russo?

steps.name: Pastry Shop Owner
steps.text: You're a leader in your famiglia, and an honorable one at that. I can tell.

steps.name: Pastry Shop Owner
steps.text: I want to trust you.

steps.name: Pastry Shop Owner
steps.text: But you live in a different world from me.

steps.name: Pastry Shop Owner
steps.text: Even if what you say is true, I will never see it play out, nor will my sister.

steps.name: Pastry Shop Owner
steps.text: I know how the famiglie get their revenge. They send presents to your doorstep: a hand, a foot, maybe an ear or two.

steps.name: Pastry Shop Owner
steps.text: If that is the only way justice is served, then at least...

steps.name: Pastry Shop Owner
steps.text: I want to see it with my own eyes.

steps.name: Pastry Shop Owner
steps.text: After our first meeting, Judge Russo took me to meet some people.

steps.name: Pastry Shop Owner
steps.text: Those people... are just like me.

steps.name: Pastry Shop Owner
steps.text: I'm going to go meet with them again now.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: Can I come with you?

steps.name: Pastry Shop Owner
steps.text: If you wish.
He follows Ennio to a restaurant, where people are already waiting.
Most of them wear a look of grief, and some have visible disabilities.

When they see Leontuzzo following Ennio, they do not react much. They simply move the tables aside, arrange the chairs into a circle, and begin taking their seats one after another. Ennio sits down with them.
Leontuzzo stands at the entrance, silently observing the entire scene.

steps.name: Victim A
steps.text: Today, we gather to share our sorrows with our friends.

steps.name: Pastry Shop Owner
steps.text: I'll go first.

steps.name: Pastry Shop Owner
steps.text: My sister discovered that her boyfriend, a mafioso, was secretly smuggling goods with other famiglie, and as a result, her vocal cords were destroyed.

steps.name: Victim A
steps.text: My daughter tried to take her own life on numerous occasions at home. I had to tie her down. Her abuser shows no signs of remorse. In fact they are still trying to take her away from me.

steps.name: Victim B
steps.text: My little brother...
The victims share stories of terrible things that have happened to them or people around them.
Some people are angry, others are crying, and others are almost too pained to speak.
Yet, they console one another, like brothers and sisters.

steps.name: Victim B
steps.text: Our dear friends and family, or even ourselves, have suffered injustice at the hands of the famiglie—some have died, some have been gravely injured, and others have been left with scars that will never heal.

steps.name: Victim B
steps.text: We are hurt, we are enraged, but there is nothing we can do about it.

steps.name: Victim C
steps.text: No. Judge Russo has given us hope!

steps.name: Victim A
steps.text: That's right. In our moments of despair, it was Judge Russo who told us that we are NOT powerless.

steps.name: Victim C
steps.text: Judge Russo told us that we should not lose faith in the law; what we should hate are the villains who trample on it.

steps.name: Victim B
steps.text: Judge Russo told us that he would uphold the law and seek justice on our behalf.

steps.name: Pastry Shop Owner
steps.text: Yes. Judge Russo will punish the villains for us!

steps.name: Victims
steps.text: Because the law must be just!

steps.name: Victims
steps.text: Because our anger is righteous.

steps.name: Victims
steps.text: Because the mafiosi should be punished for their sins!

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: It's me.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: There is something that I think I should tell you.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: The Saluzzos just sent a crew to the courthouse.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: According to our informant, it seems Enzo was spotted at a Saluzzo base.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: Tsk.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: You're going to the courthouse, yes?

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: I knew it. I was afraid you'd act on impulse.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: But, tell me why, Leon.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: This involves the Saluzzos. It's no longer just your business.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: You are the Underboss.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: Yes, and I want to remain worthy of the title.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: In that case, do whatever you think is best.

steps.name: Court Clerk
steps.text: You wanted to speak with me, Your Honor?

steps.name: Old Judge
steps.text: Yes. The famiglie have been growing more and more ruthless these days.

steps.name: Old Judge
steps.text: I've decided to give the employees of the court a vacation.

steps.name: Court Clerk
steps.text: R-Really?

steps.name: Old Judge
steps.text: Yes. Pass the message along. Everyone who is still at work can return home.

steps.name: Court Clerk
steps.text: Alright...

steps.name: Old Judge
steps.text: Are there other matters to discuss?

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: Yes. Several.

steps.name: Old Judge
steps.text: Signor Bellone...
He looks at the old man standing before him. The old man is no longer as calm as when they first met, nor as passionate as he had been the night before.
The old man just looks... tired.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: Don't you hate me?

steps.name: Old Judge
steps.text: Why would I hate you?

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: Famiglia Saluzzo is coming for you.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: If only I hadn't let him get away—

steps.name: Old Judge
steps.text: If it wasn't this Enzo, it would have been the next Enzo.

steps.name: Old Judge
steps.text: His double-dealing is just more proof of this country's hopelessness.

steps.name: Old Judge
steps.text: I think we have all gotten used to it by now.

steps.name: Old Judge
steps.text: But you, Signore,

steps.name: Old Judge
steps.text: You could have enjoyed your victory in peace. Why are you taking the risk of coming to see me now?

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: I followed Ennio and saw a support group for victims of the famiglie.

steps.name: Old Judge
steps.text: I'm a victim too.

steps.name: Old Judge
steps.text: Sixty years of loyalty, and what did I get for it? A package at my doorstep... containing my wife's bloody hand.

steps.name: Old Judge
steps.text: That's when I became one of them.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: But... from what I've seen...

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: You're just acting as their hitman.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: To uphold the dignity of the law, and to ensure that those victims who have lost faith in the famiglie do not lose faith in the law—

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: You have made a wicked bargain with the victims, signed in blood.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: You have far exceeded the bounds of the law.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: I don't believe that everything happening now is what you originally intended.

steps.name: Old Judge
steps.text: Whether they coerced me or I raised my blade of my own accord, for their sake, it makes no difference here in Siracusa.

steps.name: Old Judge
steps.text: But you, Signore,

steps.name: Old Judge
steps.text: What are you planning to do?

steps.name: Old Judge
steps.text: Did you come here to see me repent...

steps.name: Old Judge
steps.text: Or to extend your hand in charity?

steps.name: Arrogant Mafioso
steps.text: You old fool, I'm here to avenge the mafiosi you murdered!

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: Enzo, I'm impressed by your ability to adapt to your situation.

steps.name: Arrogant Mafioso
steps.text: (hushed voice) Signor Bellone....?!

steps.name: Arrogant Mafioso
steps.text: This has nothing to do with you, Signor Bellone.

steps.name: Arrogant Mafioso
steps.text: I am here on behalf of Famiglia Saluzzo. I shall avenge the countless mafiosi that have died by this bastardo's wicked, bloody hands!

steps.name: Arrogant Mafioso
steps.text: As for the misunderstandings between us, we shall discuss those later.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: So, you've got the Saluzzos backing you now.

steps.name: Arrogant Mafioso
steps.text: Y-yes. What of it?!

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: That's good then.

steps.name: Arrogant Mafioso
steps.text: What are you doing?!

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: Demetri.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: You called?

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: Tie them all up. Then go give my regards to the Saluzzos. Ask them to send someone a bit higher up the food chain.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: At once.

steps.name: Old Judge
steps.text: What are you planning, Signor Bellone?

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: I will give you two options.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: The first option is to reopen Enzo's case. This time, I'll be present, and so will associates of Famiglia Saluzzo.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: I guarantee the trial will be safe.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: The second option: leave this place.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: Out of respect for the law, I will escort you to the city gates, but beyond that, we cannot guarantee your safety.

steps.name: Old Judge
steps.text: You are serious about this?

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: Of course.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: I also guarantee that the judgment you issue will be carried out.

steps.name: Old Judge
steps.text: Then, obviously, I pick the first option.

steps.name: Old Judge
steps.text: Even if I were to die immediately after this trial, I would gladly choose this option.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: You will not die. Otherwise, I wouldn't know how to explain all this to Lavinia.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: You need to give her a message from me—

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: In the future, if and when she travels to Volsinii, the Bellones will protect her, as always.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: Now, go prepare to reopen the case.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: You never told me about this. My teacher never told me about this.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: Back then, telling you would have only hurt you.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: Judge Russo was planning to tell you, before his death.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: But I told him I'd tell you when the time was right.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: You picked a good time, indeed.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: I know you were worried that when I woke up, I would be devastated by everything that happened during Carnevale.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: But I sincerely mean it when I say—

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: I feel grateful, Lavinia.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: You see, history repeats itself.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: Back then, Volsinii was dangerous and chaotic.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: Amid the fighting famiglie, no one cared about the lives of the ordinary people, and so Judge Russo became a blade of vengeance.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: And now, although Nuova Volsinii has its flaws, the implementation of the 'New Urban Management Act' has been highly effective.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: Admittedly, in areas we overlooked, Irene came close to making a foolish decision—

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: But that was merely a close call.

steps.name: Lavinia
steps.text: I'm relieved to hear you feel that way.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: We all know that many things have changed.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: All we need to do is try a little harder... that's all.
